hypothesis: Mapping threadIdx.x to output columns while keeping the serial K loop and 32-by-32 CTA output shape should give each warp contiguous B and C accesses (and a broadcast A access), isolating the baseline lane-mapping cost before adding shared-memory tiling. This is a hypothesis; the controller must measure it.
notes: This is the coalesced one-output-per-thread control only; shared-memory tile variants are left for a later experiment. The controller should check correctness and collect repeated timings; no candidate result is claimed here.
transformations: Reoriented the output mapping so threadIdx.x varies over columns and adjacent lanes access contiguous B and C elements.
Retained one output per thread, the serial full-FP32 K accumulation, and the existing alpha/beta update.
